results.quote: Every system at Kestrel & Pine works. But orders begin in four systems, product data is kept in four places and warehouse stock is copied along a chain of four
results.finding: The thesis paragraph restates KEY POINTS bullets 2 and 3 almost word for word just before the roadmap; both readers felt they had skipped back. The spec places the thesis statement in both the callout and p02.

results.draft_locus: How Kestrel & Pine Grew ¶1 (table), Channels ¶3, ¶5, ¶6, Systems table
results.quote: EDI in the history table, again in Channels and in the systems table; iPaaS twice; GTIN, Peppol and click-and-collect each twice
results.finding: Terms glossed two or three times make readers stop to check whether a new meaning is meant; the spec asks the timeline, the channels section and the landscape table each to gloss them.

results.quote: The volumes table restates the first table's order counts (293,000, 43,000, 9,400, 118,000); I wondered whether these were different figures.
results.finding: The volumes table repeats the at-a-glance order counts without saying so; the spec's table lists them.

results.quote: Leaving aside the scripts and connectors that join them, the table names thirteen systems: eleven rows name one each, the payments row adds the stores' terminal provider and the data row a BI tool.
results.finding: Both readers had to do the count themselves; one tripped on 'leaving aside connectors' when the marketplace connector is a counted row.

results.quote: They keep the numbers by which chapters cite them, the oversell first; all but one are instances of patterns named on the previous page
results.finding: Awkward clause; both readers re-read it, and its point (numbered for citation, not by date) is not stated.

results.quote: The table lists the decisions by number… the argument is in their priority
results.finding: Both readers stumbled on W1's forward reference to W2 and had to re-sort W1–W8 by priority, with W1 and W3 in two tiers; the note that table order is not priority order arrives only after the table.

results.quote: The 2027 program names a system of record (the one system whose value counts when copies disagree) for stock, orders and product content, adds an availability service (which computes what each channel may still sell)…
results.finding: Five parenthetical definitions in one sentence; the reader read it twice to find the main verbs.

results.quote: Each part keeps its invented figures in a table
results.finding: Reader could not tell whether 'part' means a section of this page or a Part of the book.

results.quote: 'Shipped from Duiven: 336,000 parcels' equals D2C plus all marketplace orders (293,000 + 43,000), but Channels said about 40% of German marketplace units ship from the marketplace's own fulfillment stock. I stopped to reconcile these and could not.
results.finding: The parcel count from Duiven appears to include marketplace orders the channels section says ship from the marketplace's own stock; a figure the page offers for checking does not reconcile.

results.quote: orders queued for up to four hours before reaching the warehouse, because the WMS vendor's rate limit throttled the flow that created them there
results.finding: Reader re-read to resolve 'them' and 'there'.

results.quote: A sale at Duiven can take up to two hours to reduce the number a shopper sees on Amazon.de
results.finding: Duiven is the warehouse and sales happen in the channels; the reader paused over what 'a sale at Duiven' is.

results.quote: Figure 2 shows the Black Friday Oversell in full in the systems section; incident 1 retells the same facts a section later. The incident text felt like a repeat.
results.finding: Incident 1 retells what Figure 2 and the stock-chain paragraph just told.

results.quote: Pieter Smit's part is 'Bergzicht's spring reorder', but the Bergzicht example never mentions him.
results.finding: The cast table assigns Pieter Smit to the spring reorder, which never names him.

results.quote: Figure 3 lists 'seven systems', one of them PostNL, a carrier, not one of the landscape's systems.
results.finding: The seven systems counted for Figure 3 include the carrier, which the landscape table does not count as a system.

results.quote: In January 2027 it lives in three places… The marketplace connector holds a fourth copy for listings. Those are the four copies the opening counted.
results.finding: 'Three places' followed by a fourth copy made the reader stop and recount; the spec's controlling idea uses the same three-plus-one wording.

results.quote: 'the platform' always means one product, the hosted commerce platform that runs the storefronts and checkout, not the whole set of systems the book calls a commerce platform.
results.finding: Dense definitional aside in the welcome paragraph before any system is introduced; reader re-read it. The spec places the definition here.

results.quote: …delivered Thursday 15 April, a day later than promised, because Duiven's last pick wave… leaves at 21:00.
results.finding: The late delivery is not tied back to the channels section's static next-day rule ('written into the page rather than computed from the warehouse's state'); the reader made the link only after going back.

Every term on the does_not_know list (WMS, ERP, POS, PSP, OMS, PIM, EDI, DESADV, SSCC, iPaaS, GTIN, SKU, 3PL, SaaS, Peppol, D2C, B2B, available-to-promise, system of record, idempotent, event, reconciliation, tenant, click-and-collect) is glossed at or before first use; pattern names, 'sixteen patterns' and 'omnichannel' as a stage name are in already_knows.

results.quote: Every name, price, figure and incident is invented and recorded in one canonical ledger.
results.finding: 'canonical ledger' is not explained; the newcomer does not know what canonical means here or whether the ledger can be seen. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: Four channels, thirteen working systems, no order hub and no product hub.
results.finding: 'order hub' / 'product hub' used before saying what a hub is; the gloss comes in bullet 3 and the landscape section. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: Named marketplaces and carriers are real; their dealings with Kestrel & Pine are invented.
results.finding: 'carriers' not glossed as parcel delivery companies. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: In 2026, revenue is €48.0 million, gross margin 54%
results.finding: 'gross margin' not explained (EBITDA in the same sentence is). Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: two main seasons a year plus carry-over lines bring about 1,200 new variants per season
results.finding: 'carry-over lines' not explained. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: shared spreadsheets (seasonal enrichment and translations)
results.finding: 'seasonal enrichment' not explained. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: Antwerp (2025, where Belgian fiscal receipt rules apply)
results.finding: 'Belgian fiscal receipt rules' not explained. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: two weeks of phantom reservations on 600 variants
results.finding: 'reservation' (and so 'phantom reservations') not introduced before use. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: is created there, with one state model and one order number family
results.finding: 'state model' and 'order number family' not explained. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.

results.quote: W8 — Agent readiness, not agents … no shopper-facing AI agent in 2027
results.finding: 'agent readiness' / 'shopper-facing AI agent' not explained at first use. Reported by the terms reader only; not on the does_not_know list.
Opens with the declared direct statement about the previous page and this one; no dictionary, history-of or 'in this post' opener beyond the house callout.
The conclusion synthesizes across the preface's three pages and hands off with a course of action; it does not merely restate the sections.
